name: cx-sequence~p1
task: First find the key and then pick it up. After that, open the locked door, enter the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task states one chain — find the key, pick it up, then open the locked door, enter the room, and pick up the ball. The clauses capture exactly that: hard Existence(target_picked_up) as the last step with hard Precedence(key_found, has_matching_key), Precedence(has_matching_key, target_door_open), Precedence(target_door_open, target_room_entered), and Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up). The chain plus the final Existence forces every earlier event, so no Existence for the earlier steps is needed; the clues confirm every way to finish includes all five events. All clauses trace to the task sentences, all are hard as the wording requires, and the chain is satisfiable in the environment.

texts: Find the key before picking it up.
Pick up the matching key before opening the locked door.
Open the locked door before entering the target room.
Enter the target room before picking up the ball.
